using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Nivarian;
using RimWorld;
using Steamworks;
using UnityEngine;
using Verse;

namespace Nivarian_Race.Code.Feedback;

public static class FeedbackLogUploader
{
	public sealed class UploadResult
	{
		public bool Success;

		public int HttpCode;

		public string MessageKey;

		public Exception Exception;
	}

	public sealed class UploadCapture
	{
		public string LogText;

		public string Status;
	}

	public sealed class UploadProgress
	{
		public long BytesSent;

		public long TotalBytes = 1L;

		public float Fraction;
	}

	private sealed class ProgressStream : Stream
	{
		private readonly byte[] _data;

		private readonly UploadProgress _progress;

		private int _position;

		public override bool CanRead => true;

		public override bool CanSeek => false;

		public override bool CanWrite => false;

		public override long Length => _data.Length;

		public override long Position
		{
			get
			{
				return _position;
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		public ProgressStream(byte[] data, UploadProgress progress)
		{
			_data = data;
			_progress = progress;
		}

		public override void Flush()
		{
		}

		public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			int val = _data.Length - _position;
			int num = Math.Min(count, val);
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			Buffer.BlockCopy(_data, _position, buffer, offset, num);
			_position += num;
			Report();
			return num;
		}

		private void Report()
		{
			_progress.BytesSent = _position;
			_progress.TotalBytes = _data.Length;
			_progress.Fraction = (float)_position / (float)_data.Length;
		}

		public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override void SetLength(long value)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}
	}

	public const int TimeoutSeconds = 60;

	private const int SummaryCap = 1000;

	private const int DetailCap = 8000000;

	private const int LegacyDetailCap = 512000;

	private const string LocalDevBaseUrl = "http://127.0.0.1:5199";

	private const string LocalDevUploadPath = "/uploadrimlog";

	private const string LocalDevApiKey = "";

	public static string GetSteamId64()
	{
		//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		try
		{
			if (!SteamAPI.IsSteamRunning())
			{
				return null;
			}
			return SteamUser.GetSteamID().m_SteamID.ToString();
		}
		catch
		{
			return null;
		}
	}

	public static string GetGameVersion()
	{
		try
		{
			return VersionControl.CurrentVersionString;
		}
		catch
		{
			return null;
		}
	}

	public static string GetModVersion()
	{
		try
		{
			NivarianMod mod = LoadedModManager.GetMod<NivarianMod>();
			object obj;
			if (mod == null)
			{
				obj = null;
			}
			else
			{
				ModContentPack content = ((Mod)mod).Content;
				obj = ((content != null) ? content.ModMetaData : null);
			}
			ModMetaData val = (ModMetaData)obj;
			return (val == null) ? null : val.ModVersion;
		}
		catch
		{
			return null;
		}
	}

	public static List<string> GetActiveMods()
	{
		List<string> list = new List<string>();
		try
		{
			foreach (ModMetaData item in ModsConfig.ActiveModsInLoadOrder)
			{
				if (item != null)
				{
					string name = item.Name;
					string packageId = item.PackageId;
					list.Add(GenText.NullOrEmpty(packageId) ? name : (name + " (" + packageId + ")"));
				}
			}
		}
		catch
		{
		}
		return list;
	}

	public static string GetLogPath()
	{
		try
		{
			return Application.consoleLogPath;
		}
		catch
		{
			return null;
		}
	}

	public static string ReadLogText()
	{
		try
		{
			string logPath = GetLogPath();
			if (GenText.NullOrEmpty(logPath) || !File.Exists(logPath))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return File.ReadAllText(logPath);
		}
		catch
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}
	}

	public static string DetectStatus(string logText)
	{
		if (GenText.NullOrEmpty(logText))
		{
			return "clean";
		}
		if (logText.IndexOf("Exception", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0 || logText.IndexOf("ERROR", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
		{
			return "error";
		}
		if (logText.IndexOf("warning", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
		{
			return "warn";
		}
		return "clean";
	}

	public static UploadCapture CaptureLog()
	{
		List<LogMessage> list = null;
		try
		{
			list = Log.Messages?.ToList();
		}
		catch
		{
			list = null;
		}
		if (list != null && list.Count > 0)
		{
			return new UploadCapture
			{
				LogText = FormatMessages(list),
				Status = DetectStatusFromTypes(list)
			};
		}
		string logText = ReadLogText();
		return new UploadCapture
		{
			LogText = logText,
			Status = DetectStatus(logText)
		};
	}

	private static string FormatMessages(List<LogMessage> messages)
	{
		//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_002d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
		//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0032: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
		StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(4096);
		foreach (LogMessage message in messages)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder2 = stringBuilder;
			LogMessageType type = message.type;
			string value = (((int)type == 1) ? "WARNING" : (((int)type != 2) ? "INFO" : "ERROR"));
			stringBuilder2.Append(value);
			stringBuilder.Append(' ');
			if (message.repeats > 1)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("(×").Append(message.repeats).Append(") ");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(message.text).Append('\n');
			string stackTrace = message.StackTrace;
			if (stackTrace != null && stackTrace != "No stack trace.")
			{
				string[] array = stackTrace.Split('\n');
				foreach (string text in array)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("    ").Append(text.TrimEnd('\r')).Append('\n');
				}
			}
			stringBuilder.Append('\n');
		}
		return stringBuilder.ToString();
	}

	private static string DetectStatusFromTypes(List<LogMessage> messages)
	{
		if (GenCollection.Any<LogMessage>(messages, (Predicate<LogMessage>)((LogMessage m) => (int)m.type == 2)))
		{
			return "error";
		}
		if (GenCollection.Any<LogMessage>(messages, (Predicate<LogMessage>)((LogMessage m) => (int)m.type == 1)))
		{
			return "warn";
		}
		return "clean";
	}

	public static Task<UploadResult> UploadAsync(string playerDescription, UploadProgress progress)
	{
		UploadCapture capture = CaptureLog();
		return Task.Run(async delegate
		{
			try
			{
				NivarianSettings settings = NivarianMod.Settings;
				string text2;
				string text3;
				string text;
				if (settings != null && settings.UseLocalDevServer)
				{
					text = "http://127.0.0.1:5199";
					text2 = "/uploadrimlog";
					text3 = "";
				}
				else
				{
					text = settings?.FeedbackServerUrl ?? string.Empty;
					text2 = settings?.FeedbackServerPath ?? string.Empty;
					text3 = settings?.FeedbackApiKey ?? string.Empty;
				}
				if (GenText.NullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					return new UploadResult
					{
						MessageKey = "Nivarian.Feedback.Upload.NotConfigured"
					};
				}
				text = text.TrimEnd('/');
				if (!Uri.TryCreate(text, UriKind.Absolute, out var _))
				{
					return new UploadResult
					{
						MessageKey = "Nivarian.Feedback.Upload.BadUrl"
					};
				}
				if (GenText.NullOrEmpty(text2) || !text2.StartsWith("/"))
				{
					text2 = "/uploadrimlog";
				}
				string text4 = (playerDescription ?? string.Empty).Trim();
				if (text4.Length > 1000)
				{
					text4 = text4.Substring(0, 1000);
				}
				string detail = ((capture.LogText.Length <= 8000000) ? capture.LogText : capture.LogText.Substring(capture.LogText.Length - 512000));
				var payload = new
				{
					modVersion = Cap(GetModVersion() ?? string.Empty, 64),
					gameVersion = Cap(GetGameVersion() ?? string.Empty, 64),
					playerId = Cap(GetSteamId64() ?? string.Empty, 32),
					status = capture.Status,
					summary = text4,
					detail = detail,
					mods = GetActiveMods(),
					timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o")
				};
				HttpClient client = new HttpClient
				{
					Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60.0)
				};
				try
				{
					if (!GenText.NullOrEmpty(text3))
					{
						((HttpHeaders)client.DefaultRequestHeaders).Add("X-Api-Key", text3);
					}
					byte[] bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(BuildJson(payload));
					progress.TotalBytes = bytes.Length;
					StreamContent content = new StreamContent((Stream)new ProgressStream(bytes, progress));
					try
					{
						((HttpContent)content).Headers.ContentType = new MediaTypeHeaderValue("application/json");
						((HttpContent)content).Headers.ContentLength = bytes.Length;
						HttpResponseMessage val = await client.PostAsync(text + text2, (HttpContent)(object)content);
						try
						{
							int statusCode = (int)val.StatusCode;
							switch (statusCode)
							{
							case 201:
								return new UploadResult
								{
									Success = true,
									HttpCode = statusCode
								};
							case 400:
							case 401:
								return new UploadResult
								{
									MessageKey = "Nivarian.Feedback.Upload.BadRequest",
									HttpCode = statusCode
								};
							default:
								return new UploadResult
								{
									MessageKey = "Nivarian.Feedback.Upload.Failed",
									HttpCode = statusCode
								};
							}
						}
						finally
						{
							((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						((IDisposable)content)?.Dispose();
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)client)?.Dispose();
				}
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				return new UploadResult
				{
					MessageKey = "Nivarian.Feedback.Upload.Failed",
					Exception = exception
				};
			}
		});
	}

	private static string Cap(string value, int cap)
	{
		if (value == null || value.Length <= cap)
		{
			return value ?? string.Empty;
		}
		return value.Substring(0, cap);
	}

	private static string BuildJson(object payload)
	{
		PropertyInfo[] properties = payload.GetType().GetProperties();
		StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(256);
		stringBuilder.Append('{');
		for (int i = 0; i < properties.Length; i++)
		{
			if (i > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(',');
			}
			PropertyInfo propertyInfo = properties[i];
			stringBuilder.Append('"').Append(propertyInfo.Name).Append("\":");
			object value = propertyInfo.GetValue(payload, null);
			stringBuilder.Append(ToJsonValue(value));
		}
		stringBuilder.Append('}');
		return stringBuilder.ToString();
	}

	private static string ToJsonValue(object value)
	{
		if (value != null)
		{
			if (!(value is string s))
			{
				if (value is IEnumerable enumerable && !(value is string))
				{
					StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
					stringBuilder.Append('[');
					bool flag = true;
					foreach (object item in enumerable)
					{
						if (!flag)
						{
							stringBuilder.Append(',');
						}
						stringBuilder.Append(ToJsonValue(item));
						flag = false;
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(']');
					return stringBuilder.ToString();
				}
				return "\"" + EscapeJson(value.ToString()) + "\"";
			}
			return "\"" + EscapeJson(s) + "\"";
		}
		return "null";
	}

	private static string EscapeJson(string s)
	{
		if (s == null)
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}
		StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(s.Length + 32);
		foreach (char c in s)
		{
			switch (c)
			{
			case '"':
				stringBuilder.Append("\\\"");
				continue;
			case '\\':
				stringBuilder.Append("\\\\");
				continue;
			case '\n':
				stringBuilder.Append("\\n");
				continue;
			case '\r':
				stringBuilder.Append("\\r");
				continue;
			case '\t':
				stringBuilder.Append("\\t");
				continue;
			case '\b':
				stringBuilder.Append("\\b");
				continue;
			case '\f':
				stringBuilder.Append("\\f");
				continue;
			}
			if (c < ' ')
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder2 = stringBuilder.Append("\\u");
				int num = c;
				stringBuilder2.Append(num.ToString("x4"));
			}
			else
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(c);
			}
		}
		return stringBuilder.ToString();
	}
}
